d:
Madras haeekort ne tamilnadu sarkar ke us niyam ko radd kar diya, jiske tahat dusre rajyon men patthar aur nirman samagri bhejne par rok lagaee gaee thi.adalat ne kaha ki kanuni tarike se nikale gae khanijon ki aavajahi par manmani rok nahin lagaee ja sakti. samjhie, is phaisle ka aadhar aur sanvidhan ke anuchchhed 301 ka mahatva.
Thank you for watching our video!
